items.description: Guarantor subordinates and postpones any subrogation or other claim against SPV Tenant arising from this Guaranty or its performance.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall not be subrogated, and hereby subordinates and postpones any claim or right against SPV Tenant by way of subrogation or otherwise

items.description: Guarantor must look only to SPV Tenant to recoup any payments, costs or expenses it incurs under the Guaranty.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall look solely to SPV Tenant for any recoupment of any payments made or costs or expenses incurred by Guarantor pursuant to this Guaranty.

items.description: Guarantor must hold in trust and immediately deliver to Landlord any amount received on account of subrogation rights while Obligations remain unpaid.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall hold in trust for the Landlord and shall immediately deliver the payment to Landlord for credit against the then outstanding balance of the Obligations, whether matured or unmatured.
items.trigger: If any amount shall be paid to Guarantor on account of such subrogation rights or otherwise at any time when all of the Obligations shall not have been paid and performed in full

items.description: Guarantor may not assert counterclaims or set-off, recoupment or rent deduction claims in a Landlord action under the Guaranty, except where mandatory under law.
items.span_text: GUARANTOR SHALL NOT IMPOSE ANY COUNTERCLAIM OR COUNTERCLAIMS OR CLAIMS FOR SET-OFF, RECOUPMENT OR DEDUCTION OF RENT IN ANY ACTION BROUGHT BY LANDLORD AGAINST GUARANTOR UNDER THIS GUARANTY
